name: codex-blender
description: Drive the official Jimeng Blender add-on headlessly from Codex: inspect scenes, render reversible previews, and produce Jimeng links.

interface.shortDescription: Headless Jimeng preview render and upload for Blender
interface.longDescription: Enables the official Jimeng/Seedance Blender add-on without its UI: inspect a scene, render a reversible white-model or material preview from a camera, and produce a ready-to-open Jimeng link for the rendered or an existing video.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Blender scene and summarize its cameras and frame range
Render a white-model preview of the selected camera and link it to Jimeng
Make a Jimeng link from this existing preview video
